source: UD-EWT train (gold heads/POS). Competition Model, configuration-conditioned: activation(role) = log P(role) + [log P(role|config) - log P(role)] + sum_c [log P(role|config,c=v) - log P(role|config)]; add-0.5 on config, Dirichlet shrinkage m=2 on contrasts; availability = P(value fires), reliability = max_r P(r|value).
